title: Inspection question list, draft 1

items.label: Seller's license matches a registered owner
follow: ph_family: photo of the proof (Family only)

items.label: Paint meter, one photo per panel in walk-around order: the left side front to back, trunk or liftgate, the right side back to front, hood, roof (11 panels), the panel named in each
Whole tire sidewall, clear and in focus (brand and size readable), each wheel (4): left front, left rear, right rear, right front
Tread gauge in the lowest groove, reading visible, right after that wheel's whole tire photo, each wheel (4): left front, left rear, right rear, right front
Tire size (for example 245/50 R19), each tire
Tread depth, lowest groove (/32 in), each tire
The 4 tires match (same brand, model and size)
Engine oil on the dipstick (or the oil level screen if there is no dipstick)
Odometer with the car on, warning lights visible
All keys, fobs and key cards together

Damage photos, taken in Exterior, Paint, Tires, Interior and Mechanicals: one per damage with a coin or ruler next to it, labelled in the Damages step after the camera with where, type, severity and size

labels.name: where
labels.options: damage_places: the places for the section the photo was taken in

labels.name: type
labels.options: damage_places: that place's options (the check's own problem words, or the place's own types)

items.label: Walk-around, 360°, engine off, from the left front counter-clockwise (up to 1 min)
Engine sound at the first start: start and idle (up to 30 s)
Exhaust at idle and revving, with sound (up to 30 s)
Glass and mirrors
options: Windshield chip over 1 in or in the driver's view
Side, rear or roof glass chipped or cracked

items.label: Lights
options: Headlight cracked, hazy or water inside
Tail light cracked or water inside
Brake, turn, hazard, reverse, fog or plate light out

items.label: Paint and panels
options: Hood or fender bolts show tool marks

items.label: Structure and frame
options: Pillars or roof repaired or damaged
Frame rails, floor or subframe repaired or damaged

items.label: Seats, carpet and trim
options: Headliner, carpet or trim stained, worn or damaged
Flood signs: water line, silt or mud above the rocker panels, or rust on seat rails, seat bolts or under the dash

items.label: Seat belts and airbag covers
options: A belt does not latch or retract

items.label: Features
options: Power windows, locks, mirrors or seats not working
Screen, audio or cameras not working
Interior lights or defroster not working

items.label: A/C and heat
options: One side warm or a fan speed missing

items.label: Engine
options: Hard to start or needed a jump
Tick, knock or timing chain rattle
Burning oil smell or smoke from the engine bay

items.label: Power-on
options: Slow to wake or needs a 12 V jump

items.label: Transmission and clutch
options: Hard to select a gear or grinds

items.label: Fluids
options: Engine oil very low or dry

Brake, steering or transmission fluid low or dark
EV: battery coolant low or discoloured

items.label: Leaks
options: Brake or fuel line wet or damaged

options: Belt or hose cracked or worn

Fire signs: burn or melt damage to wiring, parts or the cabin

items.label: Exhaust and emissions
options: Catalytic converter missing, cut or hollow

Aftermarket engine parts, no EO number

options: Struts or shocks leaking or worn
Ball joints, bushings, arms or tie rods worn or bent

items.label: Driveshaft and CV joints
options: Torn CV boot or grease thrown

items.label: Brakes
follow: Which wheels: left front, left rear, right rear, right front

options: Orange high-voltage cable or connector damaged
Front trunk tub or seals: water or damage
Smoke, hissing, popping, heat or fluid from the battery pack
Fire signs: burn or melt damage to wiring, parts or the cabin

items.label: Charging
options: Charge port pins scorched, bent or corroded
Charge port door or latch damaged

items.label: Road test, only when something seems wrong
options: Brakes pulse, pull, grind or squeal
Wheel bearing, tire or driveline noise
EV: motor whine, hum or weak regen

items.label: Warning lights
options: A light never came on at key-on

items.label: Scan result
options: Faults in airbag, ABS, transmission, body or driver-assist modules
Driver-assist camera or radar needs calibration
Scan tool cannot read the car

items.label: VIN, plate and registration
options: Plate does not match the registration
Dash VIN does not match the registration

items.label: Equipment
options: Missing: spare or inflator kit, jack, cargo cover, mats or anything in the listing photos

items.label: App account
options: Car not yet removed from the seller's app account
